tickerText: [TENNIS] Defending champ Ben Shelton crushes Mensik 6-3, 6-1 to reach Montreal semis vs Learner Tien today; Rafael Jodar and Brandon Nakashima also debut in Masters 1000 semis • [SQUASH] Hamza Khan and Nasir Iqbal upset seeds to reach PN Fleet Club Open quarters in Karachi; PSA Valencia Memorial Chimo Marmaneu round two underway in Spain • [BADMINTON] BWF World Championships return to India after 17 years — Delhi hosts Aug 17–23 with Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty vs Shi Yu Qi in R1 • [PICKLEBALL] Andie Dikosavljevic wins singles and doubles at PPA Asia HCMC Open; Hien Truong and Quan Do claim men's doubles gold on home soil • [TABLE TENNIS] Qualifier Diya Chitale stuns Sreeja Akula 3-0 at WTT Europe Smash Malmö; Harimoto siblings head to Sweden after sweeping Yokohama titles

newsItems.title: Shelton Rolls Into Montreal Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Defending champion Ben Shelton demolished Jakub Mensik 6-3, 6-1 to reach the Montreal Masters semis and faces Learner Tien today; Rafael Jodar and Brandon Nakashima also make maiden Masters 1000 semis.

newsItems.title: Pakistan Duo Stars in Karachi
newsItems.excerpt: Hamza Khan and Nasir Iqbal upset seeded opponents to reach the PN Fleet Club Open quarter-finals, delighting home crowds at the first World Event of the 2026/27 PSA season.

newsItems.title: Worlds Return to Delhi
newsItems.excerpt: The BWF World Championships return to India after 17 years, running Aug 17–23 in New Delhi with Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty facing a star-studded field on home soil.

newsItems.title: Dikosavljevic Doubles in HCMC
newsItems.excerpt: Andie Dikosavljevic won women's singles and doubles at the PPA Asia Ho Chi Minh City Open; Hien Truong and Quan Do claimed men's doubles gold in front of home fans.
